notes: Prices in USD for one month. The calculator treats GB, GiB and 1/1000 TB as the same unit; providers differ (AWS, DigitalOcean, Tigris and Wasabi bill binary units, Storj and Hetzner decimal), so real bills can differ by up to about 7%. Minimum object sizes and rounding rules are not modelled.

providers.name: AWS S3 Standard (us-east-1)
providers.fine_print: The 100 GB free egress is per AWS account across all services and Regions. Aborted downloads are billed for the bytes sent.

providers.name: Cloudflare R2 Standard
providers.fine_print: Egress is free but every GET and HEAD is a Class B operation. Usage is rounded up to the next billing unit. r2.dev URLs are rate-limited and meant for development.

providers.name: Cloudflare R2 Infrequent Access
providers.fine_print: Every read or copy is charged $0.01/GB retrieval. 30-day minimum storage. The free tier does not apply.

providers.name: Backblaze B2
providers.fine_print: Egress is free up to 3x average monthly storage, then $0.01/GB; unlimited only through partner CDNs and compute. API calls free since May 1, 2026 (event notifications excepted).

providers.name: Wasabi (pay-as-you-go)

egress.policy_note: egress above stored data: outside Wasabi's free egress policy (no overage price; service may be limited)

providers.fine_print: 1 TB monthly minimum, 90-day minimum per object (overwrites count as deletes), 4 KB minimum object size. Egress and API calls free subject to policy.

providers.name: Tigris Standard
providers.fine_print: Egress free with no ratio; requests are charged. Infrequent Access and Archive tiers have 30 and 90 day minimums.

providers.name: DigitalOcean Spaces
providers.fine_print: $5 includes 250 GiB storage and 1,024 GiB outbound transfer shared across buckets, including CDN traffic; then $0.02/GiB storage and $0.01/GiB transfer. Transfer to Droplets in the same datacenter group is free.

providers.name: Hetzner Object Storage (USD)
providers.fine_print: Base includes about 1 TB storage and 1 TB egress, accrued per hour (1.08 TB egress in a 30-day month); extra storage $0.0123 per TB-hour, extra egress $1.20/TB. 64 KB minimum object size. Billed even for an empty bucket.

providers.name: Storj Standard
providers.fine_print: $7/TB storage and $7/TB egress from the first byte, no API fees, 50 kB minimum object size, 30-day minimum, $5 minimum invoice.
